title: Iron Legion input bindings (content/input/bindings.json5)
description: Action to key-chord bindings (TDD 11, REQ-INP-005). One merged object per enabled mod set; a later mod's entry for the same action replaces the earlier one.

action.description: Engine action name, e.g. select_all, camera_rotate_left.

keys.description: Chords "[Ctrl+][Shift+][Alt+]Key" such as "Ctrl+A", "Shift+LeftClick", "MouseWheelUp", or a bare modifier "Alt"; key and mouse token names in Modding SDK 4.11.
